rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the covered arcade running around a monastery or convent.

example.english: The monks take a walk around the cloister every day.
example.traditional: 僧侶每日喺修道院嘅迴廊行一轉。
example.jyutping: zang1 leoi5 mui5 jat6 hai2 sau1 dou6 jyun2 ge3 wui4 long4 haang4 jat1 zyun2

rows.note: Use this for the monastery or convent as a religious place rather than for its arcade.

example.english: They decided to enter a cloister and live away from the world.
example.traditional: 佢哋決定入修道院，過遠離塵世嘅生活。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 jap6 sau1 dou6 jyun2 gwo3 jyun5 lei4 can4 sai3 ge3 saang1 wut6
